Loan management system taking borrowers from lead to closure for a microfinance lender, replacing spreadsheet and email workflows. Built on a double-entry ledger with end-of-day processing, maker/checker approvals, product rules and approval limits, and KCB bank disbursement that only activates a loan once the bank confirms the transfer — so it can never pay out twice.

Booking and point-of-sale SaaS for children's hair salons with a parent booking portal. Bookings are held while a deposit is paid, stylist rows are locked to prevent double-booking, and deposit rules handle refunds and forfeits for late cancellations and no-shows. Paystack webhooks are HMAC-verified and idempotent, and provider secrets are encrypted at rest.
Sarit Belong - Mall Loyalty & Membership Platform

Loyalty and membership platform for one of Nairobi's major shopping centres, covering customer accounts, an e-purse, vouchers, promotions, parking and delivery/pickup slot booking. Four Nuxt portals (admin, outlet, customer, security gate) sit on a modular Jakarta EE backend alongside native mobile apps, with M-Pesa payments, QR-based event parking and embedded Superset reporting.
